title: Open the Gluttony Kitchen
description: Gluttony magic deserves a kitchen capable of more than roasting whatever the Browns drag home. Establish Farmer's Spell's magical cooking apparatus in practical use. This restores the Tower facility; discovering and mastering the wider Gluttony repertoire remains its own progression.
description_completed: The Dark Tower's Gluttony Kitchen is operational. Further magical-cuisine progression remains outside Tower Restoration.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
